result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the featured restaurant image in 'Popular right now' shows a stuck loading spinner over an already-rendered photo.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar image displays a circular loading spinner centered over the photo even though the image content is already visible behind it, indicating a loading state that never cleared.
issues.suggestion: Hide the progress indicator once the image has loaded, or show it only while the image is actually loading so it does not overlay finished content.
